vo.en: You are being watched right now.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's eyes illuminated by a glowing smartphone screen in a dark room.

vo.en: Check the top corner of your phone. Is there a tiny green or orange dot?

visual.description: Extreme macro shot of the top status bar of a smartphone showing a tiny colored privacy indicator.

vo.en: That isn't a design feature. It means an app is actively using your camera or microphone.

visual.description: Abstract digital data stream with binary codes moving across a dark blue background.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. This only catches the amateur apps.

visual.description: A mysterious silhouette of a hooded man typing rapidly in a dimly lit office.

vo.en: Pull down your control center and look for the screen mirroring icon right now.

visual.description: A hand swiping down on a smartphone screen to reveal the control panel settings interface.

vo.en: If that icon is blue or shows a strange device, someone could be viewing your screen.

visual.description: A security camera lens rotating slowly, reflecting a digital screen in its glass.

vo.en: Kill your Wi-Fi and reset your permissions. Subscribe to stay protected and comment CLEAN if you're safe, which is exactly why

visual.description: A glowing digital shield icon appearing on a screen, symbolizing a secure connection.
